concept.match.description: Match Capture is the primary recording workflow for one complete EuroSkat 36er Standard Match with the same three participants.
concept.match.detail: It retains all 36 authoritative positions, including Played Games and Passed Deals, saves locally, and can be resumed. A standalone one-Game Session remains separate.
concept.match.heading: Record one complete Match
concept.review.description: Review recorded Decisions, alternatives, Result, Overbid, Settlement, and selected optional evidence from one completed individual Skat game.

concept.session.description: One Session records one individual Game step by step during play or afterward, can be resumed, and is appropriate for a standalone Game.
concept.session.detail: A Session is not automatically inserted into a Match. Use Match Capture when you are recording a complete 36-position Match.

declaration.announced: Record announced Schneider/Schwarz and declared Ouvert, not achieved levels or later exposure.
declaration.confirm_clear: Clear the declarer and declaration explicitly. Existing Plays must still validate.
declaration.correction: Correct the declaration at accepted revision {revision}. The existing continuation is replayed only until its first rejection.
declaration.count_examples: With two: Clubs and Spades Jacks held, Hearts Jack absent. Without two: Clubs and Spades Jacks absent, Hearts Jack held. Both use the positive count 2; the number does not encode with or without.
declaration.count_help: Count consecutive highest trumps held or absent from the top, starting with the Jack of Clubs, not the total Jacks or trumps. Legitimately known Skat ownership is included. Suit: 1–11; Grand: 1–4; Null: no count.
declaration.count_summary: Optional Matador count — leave blank if unknown
declaration.dependencies: Suit/Grand: Hand → Schneider → Schwarz → Ouvert. Each requires all options before it.
declaration.null: Null: independent Hand/Ouvert; no Schneider/Schwarz announcements or Matadors. Clear incompatible input explicitly.
declaration.rejected_input: Unaccepted input from the earlier form
declaration.session_count: A supplied count must be verifiable from this recording's permitted evidence. Live defenders cannot supply a concrete count. Leave an unverified count blank; do not enter unknown opponent Cards. Blank does not promise automatic inference.
declaration.title: Game declaration

guided.advanced.dataset_help: Dataset and evaluation operations are advanced automation workflows and are not configured from this page.
guided.advanced.method_help: Standard immediate analysis is the default. Bounded Search is strict and has no fallback. Auto tries Search first and may use the existing Immediate fallback. Information-set Search is selected-world, fixed-policy, and bounded, not perfect play.
guided.advanced.policy_help: Policies are fixed rule-based behavior assumptions, not AI predictions. Side-specific values keep existing precedence and may change evidence, runtime, and recommendations.
guided.advanced.provenance_help: Provenance reports public-safe field origin and information timing. It is not Confidence, probability, correctness, or authorship, and it can enlarge technical output.
guided.advanced.runtime_help: More samples can increase runtime and simulation precision. Seeds make repeated runs reproducible. Samples are not calibrated probabilities. Search uses the existing interactive budget and timing is not a quality guarantee.
guided.advanced.simulation_help: Steps count new local Decisions. Simulated opponent Cards are not hidden truth. Simulation runs only when selected and preserves the existing nine phases, fallback, ordering, and information boundaries.
guided.choice: What would you like to do?
guided.hidden_help: Do not enter hidden opponent hands. The server checks every known Card for duplicates.
guided.import_help: Import one strict SkatMind JSON object. Import validates but does not run it.
guided.imported_executed: This imported Request produced the Result shown above.
guided.imported_retained: The document is validated and retained in memory.
guided.matadors_help: Leave Matadors empty where existing inference or an unavailable value is permitted. SkatMind calculates Game value.
guided.process_local: Process-local only. Closing SkatMind discards unsaved drafts and Results. Explicit JSON download is the only export.
guided.reset_confirm: Confirm discarding this process-local draft and Result
guided.review.coaching_help: Coaching and Tactical outputs use their existing prerequisites and evidence limits. They do not establish ground truth, intent, causation, or global optimality.
guided.review.deal_help: Assign all 32 Cards exactly: ten per Player and two to the Skat. No Cards are generated or corrected.
guided.review.declaration_help: All four Null variants use the existing Hand and Ouvert dependencies. Product validation remains authoritative.
guided.review.method_help: Optional reviews assess chronological Decisions using existing Immediate or bounded Search methods. Search can increase runtime and has no perfect-play claim.
guided.review.options_help: Game validation, Result, and Settlement are always included. No optional family runs unless selected.
guided.review.output.information_set_sea: Hidden-card uncertainty review required for coaching
guided.review.play_progress: Play {count} of 30. Completed Tricks: {tricks}. Current Trick: {cards}.
guided.review.players_help: Seats are fixed. Display labels are optional and remain process-local.
guided.review.policy_help: Historical reviews retain existing fixed public Policy behavior. This editor adds no learned prediction or separate opponent-data source.
guided.review.runtime_help: Search-dependent reviews use the existing Historical Review budget profile. Samples can increase runtime; seeds preserve reproducibility. Timing is not a quality guarantee.
guided.review.scope_help: The guided editor emits normal completion only. Existing supported shortened endings, continuations, party-wide Claims, and Position post-game variants remain available through strict JSON import.
guided.review.two_discards: Select exactly two Cards discarded after pickup.
guided.rules_help: SkatMind derives each completed-Trick winner and the next Player through existing rules.
guided.run_help: Run validates this exact visible-information Position and executes it once.
guided.sizes_help: Opponent sizes mean Cards remaining. They are derived from attributed public play when possible.
guided.tricks_help: Select completed Tricks in chronological order. Leave unused rows empty.

recorded_review.analyze_unavailable: Current-position analysis is unavailable: it needs your turn and an exact playable hand. Saved recorded decisions remain available separately above.
recorded_review.coverage: {available} of {recorded} recorded own Plays have a usable saved decision snapshot.
recorded_review.diverged: {count} saved snapshots no longer match the accepted history after correction. Check the recorded history; these snapshots cannot review the changed decisions.
recorded_review.ended_without_play: {count} saved snapshots have no actual Card because the Game ended before that Play. The ending remains in the recorded history.
recorded_review.future: {count} saved snapshots are ahead of the current history after Undo. They become eligible only if the accepted recording reaches and reproduces that decision and its Play.
recorded_review.history: Open history, correction, and Reload controls
recorded_review.limit: This compares one recorded decision from the captured perspective using its frozen method and decision-time information. It is bounded analysis, not optimal ground truth, final-outcome causality, or complete three-Player Game review.
recorded_review.missing: {count} recorded own Plays have no usable saved snapshot. The recording is still supported; this view cannot reconstruct missing decision-time evidence from final hands.
recorded_review.no_observations: No Card has been recorded from the selected perspective yet.
recorded_review.no_perspective: This recording has no selected own perspective, so no own-decision review is available here.
recorded_review.no_snapshots: The observed Cards remain in the history, but no decision-time snapshots were saved with this recording. Inspect the history and available corrections; this view cannot backfill those snapshots.
recorded_review.pending: {count} saved snapshots are waiting for an observed Play. Record the actual Card through normal Card entry when it is known.
recorded_review.review_unavailable: Full Historical review is unavailable: it needs reconstruction mode, the complete original deal, metadata and a valid ending. Recorded-decision review uses eligible saved own-decision snapshots independently, without switching mode.
recorded_review.title: Review recorded decisions
recordings.empty: No recordings of this type were found. Start with the recording link below.
recordings.introduction: Choose an individual Game or Match. Partial recordings can be opened too; available review depends on the saved decision-time evidence.
recordings.lifetime: Opening another recording of the same type replaces its active context and discards its temporary Results and correction previews. Returning to the same unchanged source keeps them until an edit, reload, or restart.
recordings.manual_help: Manual review is a separate input path. This link continues any existing manual draft or Result.
recordings.match.coverage: Review one recorded decision using its safely reconstructed information. Availability is not a guarantee of successful analysis; method and evidence limits still apply.
recordings.match.historical: Full Historical review needs a complete reconstructable original deal, completed play, and an exact Match timestamp. Individual decisions are prepared separately.
recordings.match.inspect: Inspect recorded decisions and missing evidence
recordings.match.materialization: Explicitly prepare existing Match exports from the recorded evidence. This does not execute analysis and is not required for individual decision review.
recordings.match.no_observations: This Game has started, but no Cards have been recorded yet.
recordings.match.prepared: {prepared} of {total} recorded decisions are prepared for individual review.
recordings.reload.sessions: Reload the active individual Game explicitly
recordings.reload_help: Use this after an external file change. Reload replaces in-memory state and discards its temporary Results and previews.
recordings.skip.acting_hand_unavailable: The acting Player's decision-time hand cannot be reconstructed from this evidence.
recordings.skip.required_public_hand_una: The required publicly visible hand is unavailable at this decision.
recordings.storage_help: Inspect local storage information to resolve invalid or duplicate-identity files
recovery.annotations_unchanged: Comments and response links are retained; check their wording after correction.
recovery.candidate_warning: The partial candidate is accepted by the recording contract, but this evidence conflict remains. Applying it does not establish complete repair.
recovery.check_evidence: Check hand, Skat, and discard evidence
recovery.choice_guidance: Choose a proposal, then preview it with the entire continuation.
recovery.complete_replay: Completing the trace triggered replay of all Plays. The conflict is at the location above, not necessarily at the last Card.
recovery.confirm: I have reviewed this preview and want to apply it
recovery.metadata_unchanged: Game identity, declaration, hand/Skat/discard evidence, and retained Play Players, indexes, and timecodes stay unchanged.
recovery.observations: These observations contradict each other under the recorded declaration. This does not identify which observation was entered incorrectly. Inspect the relevant Trick and evidence before correcting or rewinding.
recovery.reason.discard: This Card conflicts with recorded discards.
recovery.reason.duplicate: This Card occurs twice in the proposed trace. The linked witness is the other occurrence.
recovery.reason.follow_suit: The recorded Card does not follow the required effective suit, although the evidence below shows a matching Card was held.
recovery.reason.ownership: This Card conflicts with the recorded ownership or exact playable hand.
recovery.reason.skat: This Card conflicts with original Skat evidence and the recorded declaration.

recovery.removal: Keep {retained} Plays and remove {removed} Plays, starting at {location}. Canonical removal also removes {notes} commentaries and {responses} response links. Removed Plays are listed below; the retained prefix remains in accepted history.

recovery.removed_annotations: Inspect commentary and response links to remove
recovery.replacement: Replace {old} with {new}; retain all {count} following Plays. The entire candidate is rebuilt and validated.
recovery.rewind_prepare: Open a removal preview for this Card and its continuation.
recovery.saved: Correction saved. Continue recording this Game; a previously rejected Card has not been resubmitted.
recovery.unchanged: No change: this Card is already recorded.
recovery.warning: Recording warning: later accepted evidence proves an earlier conflict. This partial recording can still be continued or corrected; complete validation remains required.
recovery.witness.known: Witness from the explicitly known playable hand: {card}.
recovery.witness.proposed: Witness from proposed input, not accepted history: {card}.

result.limit.budget: The analysis is bounded by its selected method, samples, and public budget.
result.limit.claim: Claim adjudication is limited to the bounded party-wide all-remaining-Tricks form.
result.limit.coaching: Replay Coaching is bounded to retained review evidence and makes no causal claim.
result.limit.cutoff: Only information available at the analysis cutoff is used.
result.limit.global: Decision reviews remain bounded to their retained public evidence and do not establish one globally optimal game policy.
result.limit.historical_cutoff: Historical comparisons use only information available at each Decision cutoff.
result.limit.information_coaching: Information-set Coaching uses complete Candidate evidence without fallback.
result.limit.observed: The actual Card is observed retrospective evidence, not ground truth.
result.limit.policy: Opponent behavior follows the fixed public policy settings used for this analysis.
result.limit.probability: Compatible-world counts and samples are evidence coverage, not calibrated probability.
result.limit.search: Search is not a perfect-play claim.
result.limit.tactical: Tactical motifs are structural observations, not quality, intent, signaling, communication, or causal claims.

result.no_review: No chronological Decision comparison was requested.

session.correction.consent: Remove the listed continuation from this recording
session.correction.final: Applying removes this continuation from the current recording. There is no automatic in-app Undo/Redo or recovery. An ended Game may become incomplete.
session.correction.lossless: All later entries are retained. Trick winners and party points may change with the corrected fact.
session.correction.next: After applying, the next recording task is:
session.correction.next_skat: Continue with the declarer's known Skat and discard evidence before recording Plays.
session.correction.reason.conflict: This entry cannot follow the corrected facts. The exact diagnostic is available below.
session.correction.reason.declaration: This entry conflicts with the corrected declaration or its required evidence.
session.correction.reason.knowledge: This entry is not permitted by the recording's information scope.
session.correction.reason.ownership: This Card conflicts with recorded ownership.
session.correction.reason.phase: This entry is not allowed at the resulting recording stage. Supply the required evidence through normal recording first.
session.correction.reason.turn: The recorded Player is no longer next to play. Players are not reassigned automatically.
session.correction.removal: Remove {plays} Plays and {other} other Commands, including the first conflicting entry and everything after it.
session.correction.removed_details: Inspect every entry to be removed
session.correction.result: Applying a real change discards this Session's current analysis Result. Saved decision snapshots retain their existing lineage rules.
session.correction.retained: Retained in the candidate: {plays} Plays. Retained continuation after the changed fact: {records} Commands.
session.correction.title: Correction preview — nothing saved yet
session.correction.unchanged: No change: the accepted fact and full original continuation are already retained. Applying saves nothing and keeps the current Result.

settings.players.platform_ids_help: Enter at most 16 lines in the form Platform = Player ID.

settings.players.recordings_unchanged: Existing recordings and their participants, names and evidence remain unchanged.
settings.players.removal_own: Your player preference will be cleared.
settings.players.removal_preferred: The retained legacy preferred-perspective reference will be cleared.
settings.preferences.advanced_help: Optional Match creation details start open. This does not make them required or change their values.

settings.recommended_reset.help: This preserves the selected language, saved Players, own Player, and managed display names.

task.learning.automatic: Adding and building require explicit actions. The first added version becomes selected; later added versions keep the existing selection.
task.learning.binding.non_current: Source belongs to a different saved version
task.learning.build_help: Build descriptive cross-game summaries from the selected saved versions and evidence. This does not run decision analysis or train a model.
task.learning.coverage_help: Coverage counts only the selected recorded evidence, not completion of all 36 positions or Player strength. Zero decisions means no decision evidence. No analysis evidence means no coaching assessment, not zero mistakes. Results are process-local; reopening or restarting can require an explicit rebuild.
task.learning.current_results: These Results use the current selections. Changing sources or selections invalidates them; opening this section does not rebuild them.
task.learning.dataset.complete: All observed decisions have usable records
task.learning.dataset.partial: Some observed decisions have usable records
task.learning.discovery_limit: The saved-Match list is truncated at the existing 2,048-candidate limit. Only the displayed available choices can be added.

task.learning.empty.review: Review or download the resulting summaries.
task.learning.empty.select: Choose the saved Match version to use.
task.learning.import.conflict: The copy of {name}, saved revision {revision}, encountered a collection conflict. Reload the collection explicitly before trying again. A published immutable copy can remain unselected as an orphan.
task.learning.import.resolution: Different content for {name}, saved revision {revision}, is already retained. Nothing changed. Under Advanced, explicitly choose to retain both versions if intended, then add again.
task.learning.import.retained: Added {name}, saved revision {revision}, while keeping the previously selected version. Choose a different version explicitly below if wanted. Prepared results were cleared; rebuild explicitly.
task.learning.import.selected: Added and selected {name}, saved revision {revision}. Build summaries explicitly when ready.
task.learning.import.unchanged: {name}, saved revision {revision}, is already present with identical content. The selection and any prepared results are unchanged.
task.learning.missing_selection: No version is selected for this Match. Explicitly choose one below before its evidence can be used.
task.learning.next.add: Choose a saved Match below and explicitly add its saved version to this collection.
task.learning.next.build: Selected Match evidence is available. Build insights when you are ready.
task.learning.next.results: Summaries for the selected evidence are ready. View their coverage and downloads below.
task.learning.next.select: Choose the saved Match version to use before building insights.
task.learning.next.sources: A Report source belongs to a different version. Remove that source using the visible controls below, or restore its matching version, before building.
task.learning.no_recorded: No actionable saved Match is listed. Refresh after saving one; invalid or duplicate-identity files need local storage resolution.
task.learning.no_results: No current Results are available. Complete the prerequisites and explicitly build insights.
task.learning.open_to_add: Open this Match to add it
task.learning.recorded_help: Add copies the current valid saved version when you submit, without opening the recording. Empty and partial Matches are allowed. The first version of a new Match becomes selected; updates are retained while keeping the selected version. Later source edits or deletion do not change these independent copies.
task.learning.recorded_unavailable: Saved item {number}: {reason}. It cannot be added; resolve its local storage problem first.
task.learning.settings_help: Defaults are deterministic: seeds 0 and 0, partition weights 70 / 15 / 15. Changes apply only to this explicit build and are not saved as preferences.
task.learning.sources_help: Strategy Teacher sources must be exact executed decision Reports bound to a selected saved Match version. Non-current sources block building until explicitly removed or replaced. Choose an upload file again after a validation failure.
task.learning.versions_help: Each selected version is immutable. A later Match edit is not included until explicitly added and selected. Unselected Matches contribute no evidence.
task.match.all_complete: All 36 entries are passed or have complete play traces. Optional evidence and corrections remain available.
task.match.annotations_blocked: Record a Card before attaching commentary to its decision.
task.match.annotations_help: Keep observed commentary separate from later response links. A link does not establish intent or causation.
task.match.blocker.complete_play_trace: All 30 Cards are recorded. Continue with another position or correct existing evidence.
task.match.blocker.empty_slot: Start this Game or mark it passed.
task.match.blocker.missing_declaration: Choose the declarer and declaration before Card play.
task.match.blocker.passed_deal: This position is passed. Clear it explicitly before recording a Game.
task.match.correction_help: Corrections use the existing saved revision. Truncation removes later Plays and reconciles linked commentary. Replacing or clearing occupied positions requires confirmation.
task.match.decision_blocked: Record a decision and enough hand or complete-trace evidence to reconstruct its safe perspective before analysis.
task.match.evidence_help: Record exact Cards only when known. Unknown evidence remains unknown; a known-empty discard belongs to a Hand game. Missing evidence may limit analysis but does not invent hidden ownership.
task.match.historical_blocked: Completed-game review requires the complete reconstructable deal, Skat/discard evidence, all 30 Plays, and the exact Match played time. Complete those facts before requesting strict review.
task.match.metadata_help: The source describes the observation, independently of the platform and recording format. Source titles and timecodes describe supplied evidence only. No source is fetched. Video-only fields must remain empty for manual observation.
task.match.navigation_help: You can record Games out of order or revisit any Game to inspect or correct it.
task.match.next.append_plays: Record the next observed Card. Add exact hand or Skat evidence below when available.
task.match.next.passed_deal: This Game is marked as a passed deal.
task.match.next.play_complete: This Game has all 30 Plays. You can review the entered evidence.
task.match.next.set_declaration: Choose who became declarer and which game was declared. Hand and Skat evidence can be added below.
task.match.next.start_game: Record this Game or mark the deal passed. No Game ID or timecode is needed.
task.match.progress_value: {observed} started Games, {complete} with complete play traces; {passed} passed deals. 36 entries in total.
task.match.record_or_pass: Record this game or mark it passed
task.match.remove_note_help: Removing commentary also removes its response links.
task.match.reports_help: Reports remain in this process and are invalidated by changes or Reload. Exports are prepared only after explicit submission and run no analysis.
task.match.scope.bounded_observation_can: Bounded observation candidates: ownership may be unknown. Choose only the Card actually observed.
task.match.scope.exact_legal_cards: Exact legal Cards from the currently known playable hand.
task.match.scope.unavailable: Card entry is unavailable. Complete the required declaration or choose another Game.
task.match.statistics: Advanced Player Statistics and prepared Profiles
task.match.statistics_help: Statistics are optional Match-bound evidence. Enter all eight percentages; exact counts must be all supplied or all absent. Only observations strictly before the Match are eligible for supported analysis.
task.operation.conflict: The saved state changed. Reload explicitly before retrying.
task.operation.partial: The correction was saved, but replay of later entries stopped at the first rejection. Review the accepted history and record the missing later entries again.
task.operation.rejected: The submitted operation was not applied. Review the form and its prerequisites.
task.operation.reloaded: Recording reloaded. Process-local results were discarded; run the required analysis or preparation explicitly again.
task.session.analysis_blocked: Analysis needs a playable local decision; completed-game review needs a complete retrospective record. Resolve the applicable prerequisites below.
task.session.card_help: Record the Card actually played. Existing turn order, ownership, duplicate, and follow-suit checks remain authoritative.
task.session.correction_help: Choose the accepted revision to replace. Later Commands are replayed until the first rejection. Undo retains only the requested prefix; review the resulting state before continuing.
task.session.event_help: Record only the supported event observed. Relevant Player, Card, consent, and exposure fields are required for the selected ending; unrelated fields are ignored by the existing parser.
task.session.metadata_help: You can enter Cards directly. The first initial-Card save supplies a missing game identity from this Session. Add a known date and time here only if wanted.
task.session.next.complete: The ending is recorded. Review eligible saved decisions below, or open history and corrections. Full Historical review has separate evidence requirements.
task.session.next.promote_to_retrospecti: The game has ended. Explicitly continue after the game under optional actions if retrospective recording is needed.
task.session.next.record_dealt_card: Select the requested known Cards together and save once. Missing Cards stay unknown until explicitly entered at an accepted point.
task.session.next.record_discard: Select the declarer’s known discards together and save once. Two discarded Cards are required in total.
task.session.next.record_play: Record the next Player's observed Card.
task.session.next.set_declaration: Record the declared game and its announcements.
task.session.next.set_declarer: Choose the Player who became declarer.
task.session.next.set_game_end: All 30 Cards are recorded. Confirm normal completion.
task.session.next.set_game_metadata: Save the missing game details for this recording.
task.session.next.set_public_hand: Record the exact publicly visible Ouvert declarer hand before analyzing this decision.
task.session.normal_end: Confirm that the Game ended normally after ten complete tricks.
task.session.phase_help.deal: Record the known deal. The existing rules advance the phase only after an accepted entry completes the required evidence.
task.session.phase_help.declaration: Choose the declarer and record the declaration.
task.session.phase_help.ended: The recorded ending is retained. Review and correction remain explicit actions.
task.session.phase_help.play: Enter observed Cards in order. Record permitted public-hand facts only at their accepted point, never backfilled from later play. The existing rules determine who acts next.
task.session.phase_help.setup: The three Players are retained. Select the known initial Cards and save them together. Game details are optional.
task.session.phase_help.skat_and_discard: Record the legitimately known Skat and the declarer's two discards.
task.session.promotion_help: This explicit one-way Command changes recording scope. It adds no facts, rewinds no phase and does not make full Historical review ready. During play or after ending, it does not reopen initial-deal entry. There is no downgrade toggle; existing Undo and history correction are separate.
task.session.public_help: Enter exact Card codes for the rule-authorized public hand. This does not permit recording hidden opponent Cards.
task.session.readiness.historical.captur: Full Historical review/export requires reconstruction mode as well as complete original evidence. Switching mode alone supplies no missing Cards. Eligible saved decisions can be reviewed in the current mode.
task.session.readiness.historical.declar: Full Historical review/export requires the declarer and declaration.
task.session.readiness.historical.discar: Full Historical review/export requires a valid Hand-game or two-discard record.
task.session.readiness.historical.game_e: Full Historical review/export requires a valid recorded ending.
task.session.readiness.historical.game_i: Full Historical review/export requires Game identity recorded before ending. For an ended record, inspect history and correction.
task.session.readiness.historical.initia: Full Historical review/export requires all three initial hands and the original Skat. Switching mode during play or after ending does not reopen deal entry. Existing Undo and history correction are separate operations.
task.session.readiness.historical.phase: Full Historical review/export requires an explicitly ended recording.
task.session.readiness.position.declarat: For decision analysis, record the declaration.
task.session.readiness.position.declarer: For decision analysis, choose the declarer.
task.session.readiness.position.exact_pu: For this Ouvert decision, record the public declarer hand.
task.session.readiness.position.game_end: An ended Game has no current decision. Eligible saved decisions remain reviewable above.
task.session.readiness.position.local_pl: This record has no selected perspective for current-decision analysis.
task.session.readiness.position.next_pla: Record the preceding observed Plays until the perspective Player acts next.
task.session.readiness.position.phase: Current-decision analysis is available during Card play.
task.session.readiness.position.remainin: Decision analysis requires the exact remaining perspective hand.
task.session.specialist_analysis: Other analysis: current position and full Historical review
task.statistics.profile: Prepared Profiles remain descriptive until explicitly enabled in supported analysis. Exact classifications and evidence are in Technical details.
task.statistics.temporal.captured_not_be: Recorded at or after Match start: descriptive only.
task.statistics.temporal.eligible: Recorded strictly before Match start: eligible for supported analysis.
task.statistics.temporal.match_time_unav: The Match start time is unknown; time-safe application is unavailable.

task.transfer.choices_help: A Match's first import becomes its selected version under the existing import contract. For later imports, choose whether to use the imported version or keep the existing selection. On different content at the same revision, the default requires resolution; retaining both never merges them.
task.transfer.default_selection: This explicit action adds the saved Match version. The first version is selected for insights. For an already added Match, the default selects the imported version; Advanced settings can keep the existing selection.
task.transfer.exists: This Match already has a saved version in the collection.
task.transfer.heading: Add this Match to Learning
task.transfer.help: Transfer one strictly verified saved Match record, including its observed Games and commentary. No analysis, preparation, or Dataset build runs.
task.transfer.new: This Match has not yet been added to the collection.
task.transfer.open_collection: Open a learning collection first, then return to this Match to add it explicitly.
task.transfer.report_help: Only an eligible current decision Report can be bound to the exact selected saved Match version. A Historical Report is not a Strategy Teacher source.
task.transfer.select_imported: Use the imported version for insights

validation.card_entry.empty: Select at least one Card before saving.

validation.declaration.count_mismatch: The supplied count contradicts exact known ownership. Check the count or leave it blank; no declaration was saved.
validation.declaration.count_unverifiabl: This count cannot be verified from the permitted evidence. Live defenders cannot supply concrete Matadors. Leave the optional count blank.
validation.declaration.declarer: Select a named declarer before saving the declaration.
validation.declaration.duplicate: This field was sent more than once. Use each declaration control only once.
validation.declaration.fields: The declaration form is incomplete or has unsupported fields. Use the current controls and submit each field only once.
validation.declaration.file_changed: The saved recording changed or could not be verified. No declaration was saved. Use the explicit Reload control before continuing.
validation.declaration.flag: Use the displayed checkbox once for this option; unchecked means false.
validation.declaration.game_type: Choose one of the six displayed game types.
validation.declaration.grand_count: For Grand, enter a count from 1 through 4, or leave it blank if unknown.
validation.declaration.integer: Enter a whole number, or leave this optional value blank.
validation.declaration.null_announcement: Announced Schneider and Schwarz do not apply to Null. Uncheck the incompatible options explicitly, or correct the game type.
validation.declaration.null_matadors: Matadors do not apply to Null. Clear the count explicitly, or correct the game type.
validation.declaration.ouvert_requires: Suit/Grand Ouvert requires Hand, Schneider announced and Schwarz announced. Correct the actual options explicitly; none were changed for you.
validation.declaration.positive: Enter a positive whole number, or leave it blank if unknown. Zero is not an unknown value.
validation.declaration.rejected: The current phase or accepted history does not permit this declaration. Inspect the recording and use its explicit historical correction when needed.
validation.declaration.save_failed: The declaration could not be saved. The accepted recording is unchanged. Check local storage and retry from the current form.
validation.declaration.schneider_announc: Announced Schneider requires Hand for Suit/Grand. Select Hand only if it was actually announced, or uncheck Schneider.
validation.declaration.schwarz_announced: Announced Schwarz requires Hand and Schneider announced for Suit/Grand. Correct these choices explicitly to match the actual declaration.
validation.declaration.stale: This declaration belongs to an earlier or different recording. Nothing was saved. Inspect the current game and enter the declaration in its current form.
validation.declaration.suit_count: For a Suit game, enter a count from 1 through 11, or leave it blank if unknown.
validation.declaration.target: Use the declaration correction for the displayed accepted revision.
validation.deletion.invalid: Use the current deletion form and check the confirmation box yourself. Unsupported or repeated fields are not accepted. Nothing was deleted by this request.
validation.deletion.refused: The file could not be removed. Check local file access and whether another program is using it, then prepare a fresh preview. The recording was not deleted.
validation.deletion.stale: This deletion selection is missing, expired or changed. Return to the recording list and prepare a fresh preview. Nothing was deleted by this request.
validation.last_valid_result: The last valid Result remains available. This rejected submission did not replace it.
validation.local_time.ambiguous: This local time occurs twice. Select the earlier or later occurrence with its displayed offset, then submit again. Nothing was saved.
validation.local_time.correction_require: This time is already recorded. Use the correction for its accepted metadata Command to replace or remove it.
validation.local_time.database: The required packaged timezone database is missing or damaged. Repair the SkatMind installation with tzdata>=2026.4 and restart. Existing recorded time can still be kept; no offset will be guessed.
validation.local_time.date: Enter a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, from year 0001 through 9999.
validation.local_time.date_mismatch: The display date and exact local date must use the same calendar date. The UTC date is not used for this comparison.
validation.local_time.date_required: Enter the local date as well as the time, or clear both for an optional new entry.
validation.local_time.fields: Use the current local-time form with all its original source fields. Unsupported, missing or repeated fields cannot be saved.
validation.local_time.file_changed: The saved recording changed or could not be verified. Nothing was saved. Use its explicit Reload control and inspect the current recording before entering time again.
validation.local_time.gap: This local time does not exist in the selected zone because the clock moves forward. Enter the actual known time; SkatMind will not move it automatically.
validation.local_time.intent: You entered replacement date/time values while Keep or Remove is selected. Choose Replace to use them, or explicitly clear the replacement fields.
validation.local_time.mixed: Raw timestamps and local date/time controls cannot be combined. Use one complete representation.
validation.local_time.mode: Choose Keep, Replace or Remove using the current metadata form.
validation.local_time.occurrence: That occurrence choice does not match this exact date, time, zone, database and source. Select a fresh occurrence from the returned form.
validation.local_time.offset_seconds: This historical zone offset includes seconds that the recording format cannot represent. No rounding or conversion was saved.
validation.local_time.preference_save_fa: The time zone preference could not be saved. Your profile and recordings are unchanged. Check local storage before submitting again.
validation.local_time.range: This date/time cannot be converted within the supported calendar range. Nothing was saved.
validation.local_time.rejected: The existing recording validator could not accept this metadata change. Check the source metadata and correction target; nothing was saved.
validation.local_time.save_failed: The metadata could not be saved. The accepted recording is unchanged. Check local storage before submitting again.
